question: 2026年上海各月实收租金是多少？按月份升序。
gold_sql: SELECT rp.billing_month, ROUND(SUM(rp.amount_paid), 2) AS rent_collected FROM rent_payments rp JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id WHERE p.city = '上海' AND rp.billing_month >= '2026-01-01' AND rp.billing_month < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY rp.billing_month ORDER BY rp.billing_month

question: 截至2026年5月31日，各城市按面积计算的出租率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.city, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leases l WHERE l.unit_id = u.unit_id AND l.lease_start_date <= '2026-05-31' AND l.lease_end_date >= '2026-05-31') THEN u.leasable_area_sqm ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(u.leasable_area_sqm), 0), 4) AS occupancy_rate FROM properties p JOIN units u ON p.property_id = u.property_id GROUP BY p.city ORDER BY p.city

question: 截至2026年9月1日，未来三个月内到期的租约有哪些？包含9月1日当天，请列出租户、项目和到期日。
gold_sql: SELECT t.tenant_name, p.property_name, l.lease_end_date FROM leases l JOIN tenants t ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id WHERE l.lease_end_date >= '2026-09-01' AND l.lease_end_date <= '2026-11-30' ORDER BY l.lease_end_date, l.lease_id

question: 2026年8月每个项目的租金收缴率是多少？从高到低。
gold_sql: SELECT p.property_name, ROUND(SUM(rp.amount_paid) / NULLIF(SUM(rp.amount_due), 0), 4) AS collection_rate FROM rent_payments rp JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id WHERE rp.billing_month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_name ORDER BY collection_rate DESC, p.property_name

question: 2026年8月各项目的现金净运营收益（简化口径）是多少？
gold_sql: WITH rent AS (SELECT u.property_id, SUM(rp.amount_paid) AS collected FROM rent_payments rp JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE rp.billing_month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY u.property_id), expense AS (SELECT property_id, SUM(amount) AS spent FROM operating_expenses WHERE expense_month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY property_id) SELECT p.property_name, ROUND(COALESCE(r.collected, 0) - COALESCE(e.spent, 0), 2) AS cash_noi_proxy FROM properties p LEFT JOIN rent r ON p.property_id = r.property_id LEFT JOIN expense e ON p.property_id = e.property_id ORDER BY cash_noi_proxy DESC, p.property_name

gold_sql: SELECT t.tenant_name, ROUND(SUM(rp.amount_due - rp.amount_paid), 2) AS overdue_balance FROM rent_payments rp JOIN leases l ON rp.lease_id = l.lease_id JOIN tenants t ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE rp.due_date < '2026-09-01' AND rp.amount_paid < rp.amount_due GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.tenant_name ORDER BY overdue_balance DESC, t.tenant_name LIMIT 10

question: 把八月份每座城市的经营费用汇总给我。
gold_sql: SELECT p.city, ROUND(SUM(oe.amount), 2) AS operating_expense FROM operating_expenses oe JOIN properties p ON oe.property_id = p.property_id WHERE oe.expense_month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY p.city ORDER BY p.city

question: 八月哪些项目的运营开支超出预算最多？
gold_sql: SELECT p.property_name, ROUND(SUM(oe.amount) - SUM(oe.budget_amount), 2) AS budget_variance FROM operating_expenses oe JOIN properties p ON oe.property_id = p.property_id WHERE oe.expense_month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_name ORDER BY budget_variance DESC, p.property_name

question: 9月1日仍在履约的租约，按城市算每平方米月租多少钱？
gold_sql: SELECT p.city, ROUND(SUM(l.monthly_base_rent) / NULLIF(SUM(u.leasable_area_sqm), 0), 2) AS monthly_rent_per_sqm FROM leases l JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN properties p ON u.property_id = p.property_id WHERE l.lease_start_date <= '2026-09-01' AND l.lease_end_date >= '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.city ORDER BY p.city
